get.summary: Retrieves the collection of App resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of App resources.

parameters.name: publicId[]
parameters.description: Return only the resources with these public ids.

delete.description: Deletes the app together with all of its environments and their infrastructure. This cannot be undone.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of Deployment resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of Deployment resources.

Deployment logs become available shortly after a deployment finishes. While "ready" is false the logs are still being collected. Once "ready" is true the response is final; an empty "logs" array then means there are no logs for this deployment.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of Domain resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of Domain resources.

parameters.name: publicId[]
parameters.description: Return only the resources with these public ids.

delete.description: Deletes a domain. Environment URLs cannot be deleted.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of Environment resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of Environment resources.

parameters.name: publicId[]
parameters.description: Return only the resources with these public ids.

delete.description: Deletes an environment and its infrastructure. The last environment in an app cannot be deleted.

patch.description: Changes only the fields supplied; omitted fields are left unchanged. Environment variables are merged, not replaced: Add or change a variable by sending its name with a string value. Remove a variable by sending its name with a null value. Variables you do not name are left unchanged; omit the field entirely to change nothing. Platform-injected variables cannot be added, changed or removed.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of PaymentMethod resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of PaymentMethod resources.

delete.description: Deletes the payment method together with every app booked on it and all of their environments. This cannot be undone.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of Person resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of Person resources.

parameters.name: publicId[]
parameters.description: Return only the resources with these public ids.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of Team resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of Team resources.

delete.description: Deletes the team, payment methods owned solely by it, and every app booked on those payment methods. This cannot be undone.

phpVersion.description: PHP runtime version for the initial environment, e.g. "8.4". Defaults to the platform default. Setting it stops the environment from being auto-updated to newer PHP versions.

components.description: Component plans keyed by component slug. The value is a size key (e.g. "sm") or "off" to disable an optional component. Omitted optional components default to "off".

autoscaling.description: Enable autoscaling for the initial environment. Optional; defaults to true.

deployment.description: Deployment configuration. The git field is required to configure deployment; omit the whole object to skip deployment.

directory.description: Deploy directory. Optional; defaults to "/". Must not be null or empty when provided.

startFirstDeployment.description: Trigger a first deployment right after the app is created.

name.description: New app name. Omit to leave unchanged.

paymentMethodId.description: Public ID of a payment method you own. Omit to leave unchanged.

propertyPath.description: The property path of the violation

message.description: The message associated with the violation

hint.description: An extra hint to understand the violation

payload.description: The serialized payload of the violation
